item.title: What’s next for Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro after election defeat?
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro's clandestine escape to the United States bewildered Brazil and triggered a frantic search for his whereabouts. The Supreme Court had ordered the son of jailed ex-leader Jair Bolsonaro to forfeit his passports after his electoral loss on Sunday, amid fears he would leave the country due to ongoing investigations against him. But the defeated right-wing presidential candidate failed to hand them in, choosing instead to flee to the US via Argentina and Ecuador. FRANCE 24's Tim Vickery reports from Rio de Janeiro. Decenas de personas murieron este 28 de octubre tras la colisión de dos trenes de alta velocidad en la línea que conecta Madrid con Andalucía. El presidente del Gobierno de España se dirigió al lugar para atender la emergencia y declaró tres días de luto en el país. Es el segundo accidente mortal de trenes en menos de un año. item.title: ¿Por qué Claudia Sheinbaum es la mandataria mejor valorada de América Latina?
item.description: De acuerdo con datos del Gobierno mexicano, en lo que va del año se han registrado más de 3.000 protestas protagonizadas por sectores como transportistas, agricultores y la llamada generación Z, cada uno con sus propias demandas. Mientras tanto, la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum mantiene altos niveles de popularidad. item.title: UV scans uncover natural varnish that may have preserved ancient Chauvet Cave drawings
item.description: Tucked away inside a limestone cave in southeastern France lies some of the oldest artwork in existence. Known as Chauvet Cave, the site is so historically important—and fragile—that its location is kept secret and the cave is locked behind a huge steel door. And now, researchers have devised a technique to safely investigate these artworks and understand the natural varnish that has protected them for centuries. Their findings are published in the journal ACS Omega. Fuente: Phys.org.
